UI_AIM_PROMPT: Tap an enemy room to aim
UI_MOVE_PROMPT: Tap a room to send them there
UI_HINT: Tap a weapon, then an enemy room. Tap crew, then a room. Tap a system to add power, hold to remove.
EV_LANTERN_BUOY: A drift-lantern still burns at the edge of the lane, a little Light caught in its glass. Nobody has tended it in years.
EV_LANTERN_BUOY_C1_O1: The glass goes dark and the Ember drinks it in.
EV_LANTERN_BUOY_C1_O2: The Ember drinks, and far behind you something in the dark turns to look.
EV_LANTERN_BUOY_C2: Leave it burning for whoever comes next.
EV_LANTERN_BUOY_C2_O1: You pass it by. The lantern keeps its small vigil.
EV_ASH_TOLL: An Ashmarket toll-skiff swings across your bow. Its captain wants ten scrap for the privilege of the lane.
EV_ASH_TOLL_C2: Have the Kith slip them a forged ledger.
EV_ASH_TOLL_C2_O1: Three small voices argue the captain into a refund.
EV_ASH_TOLL_C3_O1: The skiff signals its friends. A cutter drops out of the dark.
EV_FROZEN_HAULER: A hauler drifts with its engines dead. Through the frost on its viewports you can see its crew, still at their posts.
EV_FROZEN_HAULER_C1: Spend Light to thaw the bridge.
EV_FROZEN_HAULER_C1_O1: Two of them wake. They press scrap into your hands and won't stop thanking you.
EV_FROZEN_HAULER_C1_O2: They wake wrong, quiet and teal at the edges. Your crew fight them off.
EV_FROZEN_HAULER_C2_O1: You take what you can carry and don't look at the viewports.
EV_TIDEWARDEN_PATROL: A Tidewarden patrol hails you. They keep the lanes lit, and they want to see what you are carrying.
EV_TIDEWARDEN_PATROL_C1_O1: They bow to it, take a tithe of Light, and patch your hull before they go.
EV_TIDEWARDEN_PATROL_C2: Run dark until they lose you.
EV_TIDEWARDEN_PATROL_C2_O1: You slip past with your lights off. Something scrapes the hull in the dark.
EV_CHOIR_SIGNAL: Every channel fills with the same slow hymn. The Hollow Choir is singing, and the song is for you.
EV_CHOIR_SIGNAL_C1_O1: The song ends in a gift: the Ember brightens.
EV_CHOIR_SIGNAL_C1_O2: The song gets into the crew's heads. It takes hours to shake.
EV_CHOIR_SIGNAL_C2: Have the Sable answer in kind.
EV_CHOIR_SIGNAL_C2_O1: The Sable sing back. The Choir goes quiet, then sends coordinates and a little Light.
EV_DEBRIS_FIELD: A wreck field fills the lane, slow-turning hulls and loose plating everywhere.
EV_DEBRIS_FIELD_C1: Thread through and grab what you can.
EV_DEBRIS_FIELD_C1_O2: A spinning plate catches the hull on the way out.
EV_DEBRIS_FIELD_C2_O1: It costs you time. Behind you, the dark gets closer.
EV_COLD_EMBER: You find a tiny ember on a dead beacon, almost out. It might take, if you feed it.
EV_COLD_EMBER_C1_O1: It catches and burns bright. You bring it aboard.
EV_COLD_EMBER_C1_O2: It gutters and goes out. The Light is gone.
EV_SALVAGE_DISPUTE: Two salvage crews are fighting over a fat wreck. The smaller one is losing, and begging for help.
EV_SALVAGE_DISPUTE_C1_O1: You turn your guns on the cutter. The salvagers promise a share if you win.
EV_SALVAGE_DISPUTE_C2_O1: You leave them to it. The comms go quiet behind you.
EV_QUIET_STATION: An old weather station, abandoned and still warm. Its heaters run on some forgotten timer.
EV_QUIET_STATION_C1_O1: A few warm hours. Everyone wakes up better.
EV_QUIET_STATION_C2_O1: Spare plating and a crate of rivets.
EV_HUSH_POCKET: A pocket of teal stillness sits across the lane. Sound dies in it. So does warmth.
EV_HUSH_POCKET_C1_O1: The Ember flares and the stillness parts around you.
EV_HUSH_POCKET_C2_O1: The cold gets into the hull. Frost cracks the plating.
UI_REACH_NEXT: Ahead lies %s. The Hush has lost your trail, for now.
UI_RUN_WON: The last Gate falls behind you and the Ember still burns. The cold will have to wait.
UI_REFIT_TEXT: The dock crew raise a system a level for scrap. Burn Light in the Ember and the reactor runs hotter for good.
UI_REACH_DONE: You reach the Gate with the Ember still burning.
UI_HUSH_HIT: The Hush catches you. The hull freezes and cracks.
UI_DARK_JUMP: No Light left. You jump dark and the hull takes it.
UI_STORE_TEXT: The price board is up. Hull plate and bottled Light, paid for in scrap.
UI_CONFIRM_ABANDON: Abandon this run? It can't be continued.
UI_CONFIRM_NEW_RUN: Start a new run? Your saved run will be lost.
EV_CHAFF_AMBUSH: You drop out of the jump into a cloud of chaff. When it clears, a raider is already sitting on your tail with its guns warm.
EV_CHAFF_AMBUSH_C1_O1: You bring the ship about. They wanted a chase. They get a fight.
EV_CHAFF_AMBUSH_C2_O1: They stop to sweep up the scrap. You are two beacons gone before they look up.
EV_CHAFF_AMBUSH_C2_O2: They scoop up the scrap and keep coming.
EV_FALSE_DISTRESS: A distress call pulls you to a cracked hauler. The damage is real. The crew waiting in its shadow with their reactors cold are not in any distress at all.
EV_FALSE_DISTRESS_C1_O1: Your first volley lands while their wards are still dark.
EV_FALSE_DISTRESS_C2_O1: They let you go, with a parting shot to remember them by.
EV_FALSE_DISTRESS_C2_O2: You make it three ship-lengths before they light up and come after you.
EV_BUOY_TOLL: A string of Ashmarket buoys blinks across the lane: PAY AT THE MARKER. A cutter idles by the last buoy, waiting to see what you do.
EV_BUOY_TOLL_C1_O1: You burn past the marker. The cutter was hoping you would.
EV_BUOY_TOLL_C2_O1: Ten scrap into the drop-box. The cutter's lamp flicks green and you pass.
EV_BUOY_TOLL_C3: Have the Kith reprogram the buoys.
EV_BUOY_TOLL_C3_O1: The buoys start blinking DEBT COLLECTED at the cutter. It leaves, baffled.
EV_BUOY_TOLL_C3_O2: The trick buys you one clean shot before they work it out.
EV_DARK_BEACON: Someone has smashed the lamps on this beacon. A raider sits in the dark, waiting for ships to come in blind. You just came in blind.
EV_DARK_BEACON_C1_O1: The Ember flares and lights them up. They were not ready to be seen.
EV_DARK_BEACON_C2_O1: You trade shots blind. They find you first.
EV_FLEEING_RAIDER: A raider tears out of the jump behind you, running hard. Behind it the stars are going out one by one. It sees you and decides you are easier prey than whatever it is running from.
EV_FLEEING_RAIDER_C1_O1: You plant yourself in the lane. It turns its guns on you.
EV_FLEEING_RAIDER_C2_O1: You both burn hard across the beacon. It gives up first, but the Hush gained on you while you ran.
EV_BAIT_WRECK: A fat wreck hangs at the beacon with its holds still sealed. It is too easy, and the raider hiding behind it knows you will look anyway.
EV_BAIT_WRECK_C1_O1: You crack one hold before they jump you. Win, and the rest is yours.
EV_BAIT_WRECK_C2_O1: You take the long way around the wreck. A raider slides out from behind it and watches you go.
EV_BAIT_WRECK_C2_O2: You turn away, but they aren't letting a ship this warm leave.
EV_WARDEN_DESERTERS: A ship in Tidewarden colors hails you, then strikes its colors. Deserters. They want the Ember, and they were trained to take one.
EV_WARDEN_DESERTERS_C1_O1: They fight like wardens. You will have to fight better.
EV_WARDEN_DESERTERS_C2: Have the Sable sing the warden's oath.
EV_WARDEN_DESERTERS_C2_O1: The comms go quiet. Someone over there is crying. They let you pass.
EV_WARDEN_DESERTERS_C2_O2: They laugh at the oath and open fire.
EV_HEAT_HUNTERS: Hunters out of the Ashmarket have been following your heat for three jumps. Here they finally close in, and their captain offers terms: your scrap, or your hull.
EV_HEAT_HUNTERS_C1_O1: The captain sighs and signals the guns.
EV_HEAT_HUNTERS_C2_O1: They count it twice and peel away.
EV_ICED_DOCK: The beacon is crusted in ice. As you clamp on to clear it, the ice splits open. A raider has been sitting inside it, cold and quiet, waiting for someone to stop.
EV_ICED_DOCK_C1_O1: You tear free, leaving paint and plating on the clamp.
EV_ICED_DOCK_C2: Have the Oru hold the clamp shut.
EV_ICED_DOCK_C2_O1: The Oru hold the clamp while your guns find their hull at point blank.
EV_LANTERN_RAID: You arrive in the middle of a raid. A raider is cutting the Light out of a tended lantern while its keeper shouts at it over open comms.
EV_LANTERN_RAID_C1_O1: The keeper swears on the lantern that you will be paid if you win.
EV_LANTERN_RAID_C2_O1: You hold off until the raider has gone. The keeper's voice follows you across the beacon, and the wait costs you ground.
EV_DECOY_SCREEN: Your scope shows a ship exactly like yours: same hull, same heat. Then the image shivers, and an Ashmarket raider wearing a decoy screen fires at where it guessed you would be.
EV_DECOY_SCREEN_C1_O1: It guessed wrong. Now you know where it is.
EV_DECOY_SCREEN_C2: Break its lock with a flare of Light.
EV_DECOY_SCREEN_C2_O1: The Ember flares, the raider's screen fills with glare, and it loses you.
EV_CLAIM_JUMPERS: A Drifter salvage claim is pinned to this beacon. The raider guarding it says the claim is theirs now, and so is anything that stops here.
EV_CLAIM_JUMPERS_C1_O1: Win this and the claim, and its salvage, is yours.
EV_CLAIM_JUMPERS_C2: Have the Drifter read the claim aloud.
EV_CLAIM_JUMPERS_C2_O1: The claim names a Drifter clan the raider is afraid of. They leave in a hurry, and the salvage is yours.
EV_CLAIM_JUMPERS_C3_O1: They fire a warning shot as you go. It is not quite a warning.
EV_LIT_POST: A Tallow trading post hangs in the lane with every lamp lit, bright enough to see from three beacons out. A dockhand waves you in.
EV_LIT_POST_C1_O1: The dockhand clamps you on and turns over the price board.
EV_LIT_POST_C2_O1: You keep your distance. Bright places draw the Hush.
EV_DRIFTER_BARGE: A Drifter repair barge is anchored at the beacon, half its crew asleep in the hull plating. They will trade, if you can wake somebody.
EV_DRIFTER_BARGE_C1_O1: A Drifter yawns over the comms and names a price.
EV_DRIFTER_BARGE_C2: Have your Drifter ask for kin rates.
EV_DRIFTER_BARGE_C2_O1: Kin rates, it turns out, start with a small gift.
EV_DRIFTER_BARGE_C3_O1: You leave the barge snoring at its anchor.
EV_CHAINED_BAZAAR: An Ashmarket bazaar is chained to a dead station, ships tied up three deep. Everything here is for sale, including word of where you are going.
EV_CHAINED_BAZAAR_C1_O1: You keep your head down and a hand on your scrap.
EV_CHAINED_BAZAAR_C2_O1: They pay for coordinates that lead nowhere, then open the stalls.
EV_CHAINED_BAZAAR_C2_O2: Someone checks your coordinates before you leave the dock.
EV_CHAINED_BAZAAR_C3_O1: You cast off before anyone gets a good look at the Ember.
EV_WARDEN_DEPOT: A Tidewarden supply depot keeps its lamps low and its prices fair. The warden at the dock wants to see that you have kept your Ember fed.
EV_WARDEN_DEPOT_C1_O1: The warden nods at the Ember and unlocks the stores.
EV_WARDEN_DEPOT_C2_O1: The wardens patch a crack in your hull for the tithe, then open the stores.
EV_OLD_ORU_SHOP: A one-room shop drifts on the beacon. Its keeper, an old Oru, has outlived three Reaches and does not hurry for anybody.
EV_OLD_ORU_SHOP_C2: Have your Oru speak the slow greeting.
EV_OLD_ORU_SHOP_C2_O1: The old Oru brews something hot for your crew before any talk of prices.
EV_OLD_ORU_SHOP_C3_O1: You leave the old Oru to their long afternoon.
EV_EDGE_MARKET: A trading post sits right at the edge of the Hush, prices chalked high on its hull. The traders keep looking past you at the dark.
EV_EDGE_MARKET_C1_O1: They take your scrap fast and don't make small talk.
EV_EDGE_MARKET_C2_O1: You jump before the traders' nerves become yours.
EV_TICKING_BEACON: Nothing here but the beacon, ticking out its old signal to nobody. The crew take a breath.
EV_TICKING_BEACON_C1_O1: The crew rest. The dark creeps a little closer while they do.
EV_TUMBLING_CRATE: A cargo crate tumbles slowly across your bow, its seal unbroken.
EV_TUMBLING_CRATE_C1_O2: It was rigged. A small charge pops against the hull.
EV_TUMBLING_CRATE_C2_O1: The crate tumbles on into the dark.
EV_LIST_OF_NAMES: The beacon is carrying a message from a ship that passed years ago: a list of names, and the words WE KEPT IT LIT.
EV_LIST_OF_NAMES_C1_O1: Your crew read their names into the beacon. Nobody says much for a while, but they stand a little straighter.
EV_LIST_OF_NAMES_C2_O1: You leave the names to their signal.
EV_DEAD_STAR: This beacon circles a dead star. It went out long before the Hush came. The crew go quiet looking at it.
EV_DEAD_STAR_C1: Search the core for anything left.
EV_DEAD_STAR_C1_O1: One last warm grain in the core. The Ember takes it gratefully.
EV_DEAD_STAR_C1_O2: Nothing but cold, and time lost looking.
EV_DEAD_STAR_C2_O1: You leave the star to its long sleep.
EV_VENT_KITH: Something has been eating the ration packs. In a vent you find three young Kith who swear their ship left without them.
EV_VENT_KITH_C1: Give them a lamp of Light to get home.
EV_VENT_KITH_C1_O1: An hour later they hail you from a drifting hulk with a crate their ship left behind. They insist you take it.
EV_VENT_KITH_C2: Put them off at the beacon.
EV_VENT_KITH_C2_O1: You leave them a ration pack and a hand lamp. It's more than most would.
EV_UNLISTED_BEACON: Your jump lands you somewhere no chart lists. Every instrument agrees on the beacon, and on nothing else.
EV_UNLISTED_BEACON_C1_O1: The readings make no sense. You file them for someone smarter.
EV_UNLISTED_BEACON_C1_O2: The readings show a fold in the lane. You gain a little ground on the Hush.
EV_UNLISTED_BEACON_C2_O1: You don't wait to find out where you are.
